title: Integrated Transport Measurement System (ITMS): System Description
description: Technical description of the Integrated Transport Measurement System (ITMS), a modular cryogenic platform for high-impedance transport, pyroelectric, and magnetodielectric characterisation in PPMS (14 T) and LN2 environments. Developed at UGC-DAE CSR, Mumbai Centre.
